description: Literal translation of the has_* guard idiom (brief v1.2, step-3 reopening). Guards appear in JSON as the booleans they are; guarded members are ALWAYS present, exactly as the wire carries them (CDR serializes guarded members regardless of the guard). has_coord_convention is false yet coord_convention is still present (its wire value); the reader consults the guard before trusting it. No presence magic, no dropped fields.
exercises: literal has_*: guard booleans appear in JSON as ordinary boolean fields
guarded member present regardless of guard: has_coord_convention=false, coord_convention still present
every declared member present; no field dropped or made conditional
